r: Mashed avocado with lime, tomato, onion and coriander.
Mash the avocado flesh with a fork and the lime juice.
Add the finely diced tomato and finely chopped onion.
Add the chopped coriander and a little chilli.
Season with salt, mix and serve straight away with tortilla chips.
A sweet and savoury guacamole, fresh and colourful.
Mash the avocados with the lime juice.
Add the finely diced mango and the chopped onion.
Add the chopped coriander and season with salt.
Half the avocados are replaced with peas.
A lighter guacamole that is just as green.
Cook the peas for 5 minutes and cool them under cold water.|Cooking|5
Roughly blend them with the avocado and the lime juice.
Add the chopped onion and the coriander.
Season with salt and serve cold.
Greek yoghurt with cucumber, garlic and dill, for nibbles or grilled meat.
Grate the cucumber, salt it and leave it to drain for 10 minutes.
Squeeze it well with your hands to remove the water.
Mix it with the yoghurt, crushed garlic, dill and the lemon juice.
Drizzle with olive oil and keep in the fridge.
A really fresh tzatziki with mint.
Grate the cucumber, salt it and squeeze out the water.
Mix it with the yoghurt and crushed garlic.
Add the chopped mint and the lemon juice.
Keep in the fridge until serving.
With grated beetroot, for a pink dip.
A colourful version of tzatziki, with beetroot.
Mix it into the yoghurt with the crushed garlic.
Add the chopped dill and the lemon juice, then season with salt.

Grate the carrot and peel the prawns.
Dip a rice paper sheet in lukewarm water for a few seconds and lay it flat.
Fill with lettuce, vermicelli, carrot and mint, then 2 prawns cut in half.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Serve with the hoisin sauce.

Dip a rice paper sheet in lukewarm water and fill with lettuce, vermicelli, cucumber, mint and tofu.
Roll up tightly and serve with the rest of the soy sauce.

Little golden, fluffy cheese puffs for nibbles.

Add the flour all at once and stir until the dough comes away from the pan.

Spoon small mounds onto a baking tray and sprinkle with the rest of the comté.

With finely diced ham in the dough.
Richer gougères, with cheese and ham.

The Japanese miso broth, with tofu, seaweed and spring onion.
Soak the seaweed in cold water for 5 minutes.
Bring 1 litre of water to a simmer, without letting it boil.
Dissolve the miso in a ladle of hot water and pour it into the pan.
Add the diced tofu, the drained seaweed and the sliced spring onion.
Serve straight away, without letting the miso boil.

Add the broccoli florets, the diced potato, the stock cube and 80 cl of water.
